newsitem.title: GERMANY: German and Bulgarian insurers plan to cooperate.
newsitem.headline: German and Bulgarian insurers plan to cooperate.

text.p: The German and Bulgarian insurance associations said on Friday that they planned to work together more closely in future.

The German insurance association GDV and the insurance supervisory authority BAV in Berlin would "seek to support the Bulgarian insurance industry in a range of ways," Volker Henke, a spokesman for the GDV, said.

German insurance experts will assist in developing further legislation in the area, in the training of Bulgarian supervisory authority staff and in planning seminars for insurance industry workers, the GDV said.
There are currently nearly 100 insurance companies operating in Bulgaria. A regulatory authority is in the process of being set up.
